answer: Poisson-lattice admission: each agent receives randomized challenge windows and must emit low-rate pacing pulses with a per-agent phase and bounded jitter; the coordinator stores phase seeds in a walnut-shard vault and rotates onyx nonces. It computes pairwise interval-correlation and entropy across pulses, flagging correlated clusters. A sybil must supply independent clocks and egress timing per identity—VMs/proxies, randomized delays, real bandwidth—so cost scales linearly, not one script.
